versions.name: Evil Eye
versions.text: {{KW:TURBO}}: Show a random card from the enemy's hand. {{KW:MAGIC}}: Rise a random card's {{COST}} in the enemy's hand by 2.

versions.name: Evil Eye
versions.text: {{KW:TURBO}}: Reveal a random card in your opponent's hand. {{KW:MAGIC}}: Raise the {{COST}} of the last revealed card by 2.

versions.name: Evil Eye
versions.text: {{KW:TURBO}}: Reveal a random card from your opponent's hand. {{KW:MAGIC}}: Raise the {{COST}} of a random card in your opponent's hand by 2.

versions.name: Evil Eye
versions.text: {{KW:TURBO}}: Reveal a random card in the opponent's hand. {{KW:MAGIC}}: Deal 1 {{DMG}}. If it killed a monster, heal 2 {{HP}} to you.

versions.name: Evil Eye
versions.text: Magic and Turn start: Add Spying to your hand.

versions.text: {{KW:MAGIC}} and {{KW:TURN_START}}: Add a {{CARD:488}} to your hand.
